summary: Both editions were reviewed independently against every clause of the supplied Greek working source. No concrete fidelity defect was identified. Both preserve the identification of the law with the Son of God, the differing jurisdictions, contextual repentance, and the distinction between suffering and pressure without suffering or denial. The bracketed sentence and its speaker attribution are retained, and the notes accurately limit their claims to the brackets visible in the supplied normalized source without asserting their editorial significance or manuscript support. Acceptance concerns these supplied drafts against this working source, not authentication of unseen editions or manuscripts, exhaustive collation, or unique interpretation.
